content.text: REMOVAL OF SOLENOID OR VALVE BODY

content.description: Technical drawing showing dimensions of a plate with bolt hole locations. Shows overall dimensions of 115 mm (4.53 in.) width, 68 mm (2.68 in.) and 20 mm (0.79 in.) spacing between holes, 6.5 DIA 0.55 (0.26 in.) hole size, and 65 mm (2.56 in.) height.

items:
MAKE PLATE TO RETAIN ACCUMULATOR PISTONS
A retainer is helpful for holding accumulator pistons in the case during removal and installation of the valve body. The plate may be made from aluminum or plastic.

CLEAN TRANSMISSION EXTERIOR
To help prevent contamination, clean the exterior of the transmission.

DRAIN TRANSMISSION FLUID
Remove the drain plug and drain fluid into a suitable container.

content.description: Illustration showing hands working on transmission case with drain plug location

items: REMOVE OIL PAN, FILLER TUBE AND GASKET

content.text: CAUTION: Some fluid will remain in the oil pan. Be careful not to damage the filler tube and O-ring.
Remove all pan bolts, and carefully remove the pan assembly. Discard the gasket.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of oil pan from transmission case

items: (a) Remove the four tubes in the numerical order shown.
(b) Pry up both tube ends with a large screwdriver and remove the tubes.

content.description: Illustration showing location of four oil tubes numbered (1), (2), (3), (4) to be removed from valve body

items: (a) Disconnect the solenoid wire from clamp.
